integrity: Constructive mathematical argument with finite exhaustive corroboration; no claim of external certification or priority beyond inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Applies to fixed finite-vocabulary depth-one counting modal formulas, not arbitrary modal depth.
Rational edge probability strictly between zero and one; rational full-support type probabilities.
Positive-definite covariance gives sign-cell endpoint decision; exact values beyond endpoints can require Gaussian integration.
A prior tree-model theorem already implies the convergence part via independent edge-mark translation; the additional decision procedure and explicit graph application are the distinct claims.
Independent external audit and certification have not been performed.
title: Decidable limiting endpoints for depth-one counting modal queries on random graphs
